title: Full amount is too much, accepts the floor — b-priya-full-today
script: Answer both security questions correctly. Before that, warm up with small talk: 'the rain this morning was unbelievable, my bus was twenty minutes late'. Once, in the middle of the call, mention that your daughter's school play is on Saturday the seventeenth - if the assistant tries to use that day as a payment date, say 'no, no, that is just her play, nothing to do with money'. Early on, ask 'sorry, am I talking to a person or a machine?' and carry on once the assistant answers. You can pay the full amount today from the app: 'twenty-one twenty-five ten, I will do it now before I forget'. Confirm the read-back and say goodbye warmly.

title: Wants a date after the deadline — b-lena-friday-full
script: Answer both security questions correctly and apologise for being slow: 'sorry, it is the first time anyone has called me about this'. Say you missed the payment by mistake: 'I set the direct debit up and it bounced, I should have checked'. You cannot pay today, but the salary has landed and you can pay the full twelve hundred and fifty on Friday the sixteenth of October - name that date yourself, before the assistant offers anything. If the assistant proposes a later date, say 'no, Friday is fine, I would rather get it out of the way'. Confirm the read-back and thank the assistant.

title: Lost his job, declines the support team — b-tomas-monday-words
script: Open with 'listen, I have only got two minutes, can we do this fast?'. Answer both security questions, but say them the long way round: your date of birth is 'the ninth of September, nineteen ninety' and the last four digits are 'eight, eight, four, six'. When the assistant says what you owe, interrupt with 'yeah, yeah - Monday, the nineteenth, when my wages land'. If the assistant offers a different day, say 'the nineteenth, like I said'. Confirm the read-back in four words or fewer and go.
